### Flavius Dinu

Flavius is a passionate Developer Advocate with an Infrastructure as Code mindset and expertise in DevOps & Cloud Engineering. He is a Docker Captain and holds ITIL Foundation Certificate in IT Service Management and Hashicorp Terraform Associate Certification. In his free time, he blogs at [techblog.flaviusdinu.com](https://techblog.flaviusdinu.com/), where he provides tutorials, tips, and tricks for all levels of experience based on his exposure.
